apps.localizedDescription:
VexSign by @iamsmmh — Based on Feather by @claration. The most powerful on-device iOS signer. Sign & install IPAs with .p12/.mobileprovision, inject tweaks, IPA Explorer (edit inside IPA), File Transfer Server (HTTP/WebDAV), Live Activities & Dynamic Island, Auto Cleanup, Batch Signing, Update All, Backup & Restore (.vexbackup), Logs & File Manager. 100% open source GPL-3.0. No ads, no tracking, no PC needed.

Credits: Feather (@claration) - Base | idevice (jkcoxson) | Zsign (zhlynn) | ElleKit (tealbathingsuit) | Vapor | Nuke (kean) | and more.
